verdict.rationale: Canny's evidence covers feedback capture, roadmap management, and MCP-based querying of feedback themes/ARR impact, but nothing shows actual product usage/adoption analytics (e.g., feature usage, DAU/MAU, workspace-wide adoption metrics) that a PM could retrieve. missing for 10: usage/adoption analytics dashboards or API, evidence of tracking how many users/teams adopt features, workspace-level usage reporting.
